{{< include ../_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

```{webr}
#| label: load opt data
#| envir: table_1
opt_data <- readRDS("data/opt_data.rds")
```


```{webr}
#| caption: age race and education summary table
#| label: age race and education summary table
#| envir: table_1
# add_p() needs R package broom
opt_age_race_data <- opt_data |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = c(
      "Age", "White", "Black", "Hisp", "Education",
    ),
    by = "Group",
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      "Age" ~ "Age - yr",
      "White" ~ "White",
      "Black" ~ "Black",
      "Hisp" ~ "Hispanic",
      "Education" ~ "Education - no. (%)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean}±{sd}",
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ 1,
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    )
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(
    header = "Race or ethnic group - no. (%)",
    variables = c("White", "Black", "Hisp")
  )|> 
  gtsummary::add_p(
    pvalue_fun = gtsummary::label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header()

opt_age_race_data
```

```{webr}
#| caption: age previous preg summary table

      "Spont.ab" ~ "Spontaneous abortion",
      "Induced.ab" ~ "Induced abortion",

    ),

      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})"

      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)

  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(

    )
  )|> 
  gtsummary::add_p(

opt_previous_preg_data
```

```{webr}
#| caption: clinical summary table
#| label: clinical summary table
#| envir: table_1
p_value_style <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == 1 ~ "1.0",
    x > 0.99 & x < 1 ~ "0.99",
    .default = gtsummary::style_pvalue(x, digits = 2)
  )
}
opt_clincal_data <- opt_data |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    include = c("Diabetes", "Hypertension", "Use.Alc"),
    by = "Group",
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      "Diabetes" ~ "Diabetes",
      "Hypertension" ~ "Chronic hypertension",
      "Use.Alc" ~ "Self-reported alcohol use"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean}±{sd}",
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ 1,
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    )
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_variable_group_header(
    header = "Coexisiting medical condition - no. (%)",
    variables = c("Diabetes", "Hypertension", "Use.Alc")
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::add_p(
    pvalue_fun = p_value_style
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header()

opt_clincal_data
```

```{webr}
#| caption: stack table1
#| label: stack table1
#| envir: table_1
# See table1$table_body
# *, †, ‡, §, ‖, ¶, **, ††
# table1 |> gtsummary::show_header_names()
# gtsummary::modify_footnote_symbol need at least 2 symbols
table1 <- gtsummary::tbl_stack(
    list(opt_age_race_data, opt_previous_preg_data, opt_clincal_data)
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_header(
    stat_1 = "**Control Group**  \n**(N = {n})**",
    stat_2 = "**Treatment Group**  \n**(N = {n})**",
    p.value = "**P value**",
    text_interpret = "md"
  ) |>
  gtsummary::remove_footnote_header() |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "Race or ethnic group was reported by the patients. Some women selected more than one category and were included in all.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["label"]] == "Race or ethnic group - no. (%)" & .data[["row_type"]] == "variable_group"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "Some patients reported more than one event.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["label"]] %in% c("Previous pregnancies - no. (%)")  & .data[["row_type"]] == "variable_group"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "Percentages are based on 263 women in the control group and 261 women in the treatment group who had had any live births.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["var_label"]] %in% c("Live preterm birth")  & .data[["row_type"]] == "label"
  ) |> 
  gtsummary::modify_footnote_body(
    footnote = "Percentages are based on 305 women in the control group and 306 women in the treatment group who had had any previous pregnacies.",
    columns = "label",
    rows = .data[["var_label"]] %in% c("Spontaneous abortion", "Induced abortion", "Stillbirth")  & .data[["row_type"]] == "label"
  ) |> 
  # gtsummary::modify_footnote_symbol(
  #   symbol = c("†")
  # ) |> 
  gtsummary::as_gt() |> 
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Baseline Characteristics of the Study Patients"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(heading.align = "left") |> 
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Plus-minus values are means±SD.",
    locations = gt::cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) |> 
  gt::opt_footnote_marks(marks = c("*", "†", "‡", "§", "¶")) |> 
  gt::opt_footnote_spec(
    spec_ref = "i",   # Removes '^' (superscript), keeps italics 'i'
    spec_ftr = "x"    # Unstyled or baseline text for the footer
  )

table1
```
